assumptions: R's prcomp on the scaled table.
bio.jane/contract.question: Where does each molecule sit on the principal components of the property table or fingerprint bits?

description: Principal components of a list of small molecules, computed as R's prcomp computes them, on the scaled property table or on Morgan radius-2 bits: each structure's scores on PC1 and PC2, every component's standard deviation and variance share, the property loadings, and constant properties left out. Indices are 0-based.

_files.description: The project: record references shaped like _subject. Their records become library documents a tool names in sequences/parts/document; a trace or alignment is found by file name.

_subject.description: The record to act on: exactly one of sequence, accession (+source), sample (an id from list_samples) or file ({name, text} or {name, base64}); record_index picks one record of several.

molecules.description: the structures: one SMILES or molfile per entry.

space.description: what the components are taken over. Values: descriptors (Properties (scaled)), morgan (Morgan bits (ECFP4)).

name: map_chemical_space

explained.description: the share of the total variance each component carries

points.description: per mapped structure: its index and its PC1 and PC2 scores

summary.description: the map in words, generated from this run
